line: Lenovo ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 (2026, AMD Ryzen AI)
config_name: ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 — Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450, 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 14" 2.8K 120Hz matte OLED

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 450 (8-core/16-thread: 4 Zen 5 + 4 Zen 5c, up to 5.1 GHz, 40W PL2)
specs.keyboard_notes: ThinkPad keyboard 1.5mm travel, TrackPoint, auto backlit, fingerprint reader

battery.notes: 58Wh. NBC: IPS config ~17.5h Wi-Fi test; OLED costs roughly 15-25% runtime (NBC noted OLED 'probably with higher power consumption').

price.notes: OLED is a Build-Your-PC option on the CA CTO (base CTO verified $2,093.55 with eCoupon). OLED+32GB+1TB est. ~$2,900 CAD after eCoupon; Lenovo CA runs eCoupon-stacked pricing.

reviews.quote: Lenovo also offers a matte 120 Hz 2.8K OLED panel if you prefer better image quality (but probably with higher power consumption).
Lenovo's updated ThinkPad T14s Gen 7 is an improvement over the previous model and closes the gap to the flagship ThinkPad X1 Carbon even further.

praises: The 2.8K 120Hz matte OLED is the screen the T14s always needed — same panel family as the X1 Carbon's best option
OLED + 120Hz scrolling makes this the T14s reviewers said closes the gap to the X1 Carbon
Still ~1.19 kg even with the OLED panel; no weight penalty worth mentioning
CTO lets you pair the OLED with 1TB Opal self-encrypting SSD for compliance work
Far cheaper than the X1 Carbon for the same panel + similar CPU performance
complaints: OLED tier shaves meaningful battery vs the IPS (NBC flagged higher power consumption)
CTO configurator pricing swings wildly with expiring eCoupons — hard to time the real price
Matte OLED coating still shows more reflections than the IPS anti-glare in bright offices
RAM remains soldered regardless of panel choice
OLED burn-in caution for static taskbar/spreadsheet work over multi-year fleet lifetimes

design_philosophy: The enthusiast tier of the T14s line: put the X1 Carbon's best display into the cheaper, more repairable T-series chassis. For buyers who want OLED image quality without flagship pricing, this CTO combination is the line's best value-per-dollar configuration.
rating_notes: Inferred from Notebookcheck's T14s Gen 7 AMD review (90%, IPS-touch config): swapping to the 2.8K 120Hz matte OLED option NBC names → screen_quality 5→9, readability_dark 9 (OLED blacks), readability_bright 8, creative_work +2 (full gamut), battery −1h per NBC's higher-consumption note. CPU/RAM/storage match entry 11's reviewed platform.
